programs.name: flash
code: scoreboard objectives add flashTimer dummy
execute as @a unless score @s flashTimer = @s flashTimer run scoreboard players set @s flashTimer 5
execute as @a if items entity @s weapon.offhand minecraft:yellow_dye at @s run particle flame ~ ~1 ~ 0.2 1 0.2 0 20 normal
execute as @a if items entity @s weapon.offhand minecraft:yellow_dye at @s run tp @s ^ ^1 ^3
execute as @a if items entity @s weapon.offhand minecraft:yellow_dye at @s run playsound minecraft:entity.breeze.jump ambient @s ~ ~ ~ 1 0.1 1
execute as @a if items entity @s weapon.offhand minecraft:yellow_dye at @s run scoreboard players set @s flashTimer 100
execute as @a if items entity @s weapon.offhand minecraft:yellow_dye at @s run item replace entity @s weapon.offhand with air
scoreboard players remove @a[scores={flashTimer=0..}] flashTimer 1
give @a[scores={flashTimer=0}] minecraft:yellow_dye

programs.name: fireball
code: scoreboard objectives add fireballTimer dummy
scoreboard objectives add BuPos dummy
scoreboard objectives add MotionX1 dummy
scoreboard objectives add MotionX2 dummy
scoreboard objectives add MotionY1 dummy
scoreboard objectives add MotionY2 dummy
scoreboard objectives add MotionZ1 dummy
scoreboard objectives add MotionZ2 dummy
execute as @a unless score @s fireballTimer = @s fireballTimer run scoreboard players set @s fireballTimer
execute as @a if items entity @s weapon.offhand minecraft:fire_charge run tag @s add fireball
execute as @a[tag=fireball] run item replace entity @s weapon.offhand with air
execute as @e[tag=fireball] at @s anchored eyes run summon minecraft:area_effect_cloud ^ ^ ^ {Tags:["BuPos"]}
execute as @e[tag=fireball] at @s anchored eyes run summon minecraft:fireball ^ ^ ^ {Tags:["Bu"]}
execute as @e[tag=BuPos] store result score @s MotionX1 run data get entity @s Pos[0] 100000
execute as @e[tag=BuPos] store result score @s MotionY1 run data get entity @s Pos[1] 100000
execute as @e[tag=BuPos] store result score @s MotionZ1 run data get entity @s Pos[2] 100000
execute as @e[tag=fireball] at @s anchored eyes run tp @e[tag=BuPos,limit=1,sort=nearest] ^ ^ ^1
execute as @e[tag=BuPos] store result score @s MotionX2 run data get entity @s Pos[0] 100000
execute as @e[tag=BuPos] store result score @s MotionY2 run data get entity @s Pos[1] 100000
execute as @e[tag=BuPos] store result score @s MotionZ2 run data get entity @s Pos[2] 100000
execute as @e[tag=BuPos] run scoreboard players operation @s MotionX2 -= @s MotionX1
execute as @e[tag=BuPos] run scoreboard players operation @s MotionY2 -= @s MotionY1
execute as @e[tag=BuPos] run scoreboard players operation @s MotionZ2 -= @s MotionZ1
execute at @e[tag=fireball] as @e[tag=Bu,limit=1,sort=nearest] store result entity @s Motion[0] double 0.00001 run scoreboard players get @e[tag=BuPos,limit=1,sort=nearest] MotionX2
execute at @e[tag=fireball] as @e[tag=Bu,limit=1,sort=nearest] store result entity @s Motion[1] double 0.00001 run scoreboard players get @e[tag=BuPos,limit=1,sort=nearest] MotionY2
execute at @e[tag=fireball] as @e[tag=Bu,limit=1,sort=nearest] store result entity @s Motion[2] double 0.00001 run scoreboard players get @e[tag=BuPos,limit=1,sort=nearest] MotionZ2
scoreboard players set @a[tag=fireball] fireballTimer 100
tag @e[tag=fireball] remove fireball
tag @e[tag=Bu] remove Bu
kill @e[type=minecraft:area_effect_cloud,tag=BuPos]
scoreboard players remove @a[scores={fireballTimer=0..}] fireballTimer 1
give @a[scores={fireballTimer=0}] minecraft:fire_charge
